integration_decision.name: ARCHIVE_LOCK_IS_NOT_PUBLICATION_GENERATION_LOCK
integration_decision.exact_source_finding: ArchiveWriterLock protects append_observations and load_observations separately; run_once then computes and publishes latest.json, audit_latest.json, and anata_latest.json using three separate atomic_write_json calls, with no encompassing run-wide publication lock. Per-file os.replace prevents torn individual JSON but does not prove three-file generation coherence. Source evidence is grouped by (family, source, role), with independently selected effective/available/observed record provenance; do not assume all clock IDs must match for arbitrary multirow sources. The sequential two-child test verifies rowB scoring ID in returned/persisted handoff, not overlapping publication. This is a structural proof gap, NOT a reproduced production race.
integration_decision.test_contract_decision: KEEP_FROZEN: do not revise the existing two-boundary no-network contract until executable evidence; positively witness B publication before releasing paused A at both last-file and first-file boundaries, per-path SHA-256/parsed provenance, recovery C, and mixed scoring/context record-ID-to-role in returned/persisted handoff. No B publication witness => INCONCLUSIVE. Then collect-only, targeted and full Capital Flow pytest.
